caption: The drawing shows a decorative arrangement featuring a woven basket positioned centrally, filled with an assortment of fruits. The fruits include grapes, apples, and pears, among others, and all are illustrated in shades of red and pink with some areas highlighted in lighter tones for depth. The basket is brown and yellow, adding contrast to the predominantly reddish fruit. Surrounding the basket and fruit are various large, dark green leaves that extend outward, intermingling with vine-like tendrils. The background is a muted olive green featuring a repeating, stylized scroll and foliage pattern in gold and beige tones, providing an ornate backdrop. Flanking the central arrangement to the left and right are two vertical columns resembling twisted, dark brown vines, each adorned with clusters of leaves. The entire composition sits on a roughly rectangular piece of fabric with frayed edges, mounted against a plain off-white background.
title: Printed Textile
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
